dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rjx3](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rjx3) Magnitude 6.4 earthquake at 143.626 depth occurred on Oct 28 2025 Banda Sea. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.6774 longitude 130.0038. It impacted 357 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
